scenes.scene_title: Full Villa Architectural Ground View Reveal
scenes.prompt: Mind-blowing 16:9 photorealistic full view reveal of the modern luxury villa compound (01_full_villa_exterior.jpg). Wide eye-level architectural shot capturing the grand 2-story glass facade, warm interior lighting, crystal-clear infinity pool, and surrounding tropical palm trees under a vibrant golden hour sunset sky. Slow subtle push-in, water ripples gently reflecting glowing villa lights. Photorealistic 8K architecture photography, zero text, hyper-attractive visual.

architectural_highlights.facade: Multi-level glass & warm wood luxury villa architecture
architectural_highlights.pool: Rectangular infinity pool reflecting lit villa windows
architectural_highlights.landscape: Lush tropical palm trees and manicured garden surroundings

scenes.transition: Smooth orbital arc camera sweep into Scene 2

scenes.prompt: Sensational 16:9 photorealistic 360-degree exterior orbital camera sweep around the full villa compound. Camera glides in a continuous fluid 360-degree circle around the estate, showcasing the glass balconies, stone walls, pool deck loungers, and lush tropical foliage (08_villa_drone_view.jpg). Sunset light flare shimmering off glass windows. Photorealistic 8K, zero text, ultimate architectural showcase.

scenes.scene_title: Slight Forward Entrance Glide Inside Villa Living Room
scenes.prompt: Breathtaking 16:9 camera glide moving slightly inside the villa through floor-to-ceiling glass sliding doors (02_inside_villa_living.jpg). Camera softly crosses the threshold from outdoor terrace into the spacious high-ceiling living room, revealing white marble floors, designer plush sofas, cozy flickering fireplace, and tracking toward the grand staircase lobby (12_villa_staircase_lobby.jpg). Pure visual elegance, zero text, 8K ultra detail.

camera_motion_control.movement_path: Direct forward entrance from patio into living room and staircase
